questions.prompt: Who can turn a seat into an overseer?

choices.why: Overseer commands need a seat a human granted.
A line grants mail and observation, never overseer.
Overseer commands require a live, human-granted overseer seat.

questions.prompt: Does an overseer need a line to act on a node or seat?

choices.why: Overseer commands are marked edges not required.

choices.text: No: overseer commands need no lines
choices.why: Every overseer command is described as Overseer; edges not required.
No overseer command needs a line.

questions.prompt: How does an overseer command take its input?

choices.why: The input is one JSON argument.

choices.text: As one JSON object: inline, @file, or - for stdin
choices.why: Each takes a JSON object, an @file path, a raw JSON string, or stdin.
Only identity comes from the environment.
